wiki.title: Counselor Jake
wiki.text:
Counselor Jake is a human NPC that can be found in the perimeters of Camp Chatty, located in the Greenwood Forest.

He is also an enemy NPC in Bigfoot Defender. He is with Edmond, Tyra, and Kaela to find and hurt Bigfoot.
